ESTABLISH – STOP SIGNS – Plymouth Avenue, northbound and southbound, at Montana St. F. ESTABLISH – MUNI FLAG STOP – Plymouth Avenue, west side, north of Montana Street. G. RESCIND – MUNI FLAG STOP – Plymouth Avenue, west side, south of Montana Street. H. ESTABLISH – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING ANYTIME – 1st Street, east side, from 119 to 233 feet north of Folsom Street. I.
